formulas.name: Uniform Convergence Criterion
formulas.symbols: S: the common domain; f_n, f: the sequence and its limit.
formulas.conditions: This supremum must be computed over the whole domain S, not sampled points.
formulas.whenToUse: The direct test for uniform convergence when a candidate limit f is already known.
formulas.commonMistake: Evaluating the error at a few fixed points instead of the true supremum.

formulas.name: Weierstrass M-test Bound
formulas.conditions: M_n must not depend on x.
formulas.whenToUse: Proving uniform convergence of a series of functions.
formulas.commonMistake: Choosing a bound M_n that secretly still depends on x.

formulas.name: Metric Space Axioms
formulas.formula: d(x,y)\ge0,\ d(x,y)=0\iff x=y;\quad d(x,y)=d(y,x);\quad d(x,z)\le d(x,y)+d(y,z)
formulas.symbols: d: the metric; x,y,z: arbitrary points.
formulas.conditions: All three must hold for every triple of points.
formulas.whenToUse: Verifying a candidate distance function is a genuine metric.
formulas.commonMistake: Forgetting to check d(x,y)=0 \implies x=y (only checking the converse).

formulas.name: Cauchy Sequence Criterion
formulas.symbols: x_n: the sequence; d: the metric.
formulas.conditions: Must hold for ALL pairs m,n \ge N, not just consecutive terms.
formulas.whenToUse: Testing whether a sequence is Cauchy (a prerequisite for using completeness).
formulas.commonMistake: Only checking d(x_{n+1},x_n)\to0, which is weaker than the Cauchy condition.
